newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks push to session highs, techs surge.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks push to session highs, techs surge.

text.p: U.S. stocks extended their rally in late afternoon, with the sharpest gains posted by major technology shares.

The Dow industrials were up about 56 points at 6765 and index-arbitrage trading curbs remained in effect on the NYSE. The tech-laden Nasdaq Composite roared 17 points higher to 1348, paced by Intel Corp.

Intel remained Nasdaq's most active issue, gaining 2-1/4 to 149-1/8 but by afternoon the rally spread across the top tech names, sparking sharp rises in personal computer makers Dell Computer Corp and Gateway 2000 Inc.
"It's not just Intel," said Arnie Owen, director of equities at Kaufman Brothers. "You've got an across the board run in technology."
Dell rose 3-3/4 to 64-7/8 and Gateway jumped 4-1/4 to 56-1/4. International Business Machines Corp was the strongest gainer among the Dow industrials, rising 3-3/8 to 167-1/4.
